$comment: Canonical blob storage layout parity vectors. Pins the contract in docs/BLOB_STORAGE_LAYOUT.md: the relative file/tombstone path derived from a hash, the S3 key derived from a hash + prefix, which entry names under blake3/ are canonical vs. foreign (must be silently skipped by readers/GC, never touched), and the delegate presign protocol v1 request shape. Consumed by: server/server/tests/blob_layout_vectors.rs and server/s3-blobs/tests/blob_layout_vectors.rs (Rust) and hosts/dotnet/tests/NodalMerge.DotNetHost.Tests/BlobLayoutParityTests.cs (.NET). If you change the layout or protocol, this file, both harnesses, and docs/BLOB_STORAGE_LAYOUT.md must move together.

path_vectors.description: the canonical relative blob path under a blob root, flat, no sharding, no extension
S3 direct key with the default path_prefix ("blobs/")
S3 direct key with an app-chosen prefix (e.g. SpeechSlate's "assets/") — the prefix is deployment config, never constrained by this contract
S3 direct key with an empty prefix (bucket root) — also a valid, conformant configuration

name_conformance_vectors.description: uppercase hex is not canonical, even though it round-trips as valid hex — writers must always produce lowercase; readers/GC must treat this as foreign and skip it, never adopt or delete it
name_conformance_vectors.name: A123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

name_conformance_vectors.description: 63 chars — one short of a full Blake3 digest
name_conformance_vectors.name: 123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

name_conformance_vectors.description: 65 chars — one over a full Blake3 digest
name_conformance_vectors.name: 00123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef

name_conformance_vectors.description: legacy .blob extension is not canonical even though the first 64 chars are valid hex
name_conformance_vectors.name: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.blob

delegate_protocol_v1_vectors.description: golden PUT request body — room/namespace are metadata only and must never influence the app's key derivation
golden GET request body — no size/content_type field
golden response — url only, no expiry field; the caller computes its own expiry from the ttl_seconds it sent

encoding_vectors_v3.description: v3 (BLOB_STORAGE_LAYOUT.md §8): the zstd-encoded file for a hash sits beside the identity path with a .zst suffix; the hash is Blake3 of the DECOMPRESSED bytes
tombstones are keyed by bare hex regardless of the stored encoding — one tombstone covers whichever encoding exists
S3 key for a client-side-compressed upload (Phase 4 seam): prefix + blake3/<hex>.zst
if both blake3/<hex> and blake3/<hex>.zst exist (writers never do this), readers prefer the identity file; GC may delete the .zst duplicate

name_conformance_vectors_v3.description: v3 readers/GC recognize <64-lowercase-hex>.zst as a canonical (zstd-encoded) entry; pre-v3 readers treat it as foreign and skip it — degraded but never corrupt or deleted
name_conformance_vectors_v3.name: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.zst

name_conformance_vectors_v3.description: only .zst is a recognized encoding suffix; any other suffix stays foreign
name_conformance_vectors_v3.name: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.gz

name_conformance_vectors_v3.description: the hex part must still be 64 lowercase hex — the suffix does not relax the naming rule
name_conformance_vectors_v3.name: A123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.zst

name_conformance_vectors_v3.description: exactly one .zst suffix; anything else is foreign
name_conformance_vectors_v3.name: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef.zst.zst

name_conformance_vectors_v3.description: the v2 identity form remains canonical in v3
name_conformance_vectors_v3.name: 0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef
